title: Chapter 81
text:
As expected, Carl did not choose to wait. Instead, he sent his troops ahead of time!

Zhang Wei slammed the table and cursed, "Damn it! Brother Xiao, you helped them get the intel, but those people from Hesla don't care about our lives!"

Han Xiao, on the other hand, had expected this. His expression remained as calm as ever, which made the two of them wonder why he was so calm. Through the earpiece, he instructed Lin Yao and Lambert, "You two continue to hide. Remember to protect yourselves while carrying out the mission. We're leaving."

"Understood!"

Zhang Wei and Li Ya Lin looked solemn. The heavy truck was not far from the Dark Crow Valley base. When the Dark Crow Valley was in a state of war, they would not hesitate to increase their defense. The tracks of the heavy truck would be discovered very soon.

There was no time to waste.

"Li Ya Lin, go and drive!"

Li Ya Lin was a martial artist, and she lacked long-range attacks on high-speed vehicles. She had no objections to this arrangement.

Han Xiao and Zhang Wei stayed in the cargo compartment, and they had the ability to counterattack.

Li Ya Lin did not care about hiding her tracks. She stepped on the accelerator, and the engine of the heavy truck roared to life. The tires kicked up a cloud of dirt as they started to move.

Soon, a series of engine sounds could be heard from afar. Han Xiao looked out of the window and saw a large group of Germinal Organization's armored off-road vehicles chasing after them. The headlights of the pursuers appeared in his field of vision. There were more than ten of them, and they were equipped with mounted machine guns.

"We've been discovered." Zhang Wei's heart sank.

Han Xiao did not care about the bumpy ride of the heavy truck. He opened the weapon box and started to prepare his weapons. A chase was unavoidable!

"Ya Lin, drive faster!" Zhang Wei shouted.

"I know!" Li Ya Lin bit her lips and kept changing gears to increase the speed. The engine of the heavy truck was at full power, and it let out a beast-like roar. The huge anti-skid tires left deep ruts in the forest. The mountainous terrain was undulating, and the dirt road was rugged. Even though the chassis' air spring suspension was able to reduce the vibration of the wheels time and time again, the car was still very bumpy.

Han Xiao looked out of the cargo compartment's window. The Germinal Organization's armored off-road vehicles were getting closer.

"Can't you go a little faster?!" Zhang Wei urged.

"This is a heavy truck, not a sports car!" Li Ya Lin was exasperated.

Han Xiao suddenly said, "There are four buttons next to the gear. All of them are nitrogen accelerators."

"You installed a nitrogen accelerator on the heavy truck?!" Li Ya Lin was stunned. Then she became excited and was about to press the button when Han Xiao hurriedly stopped her.

"We're in the forest now. Aren't you afraid that the car will crash? Wait until we reach the plains before speeding up!"

Da da da da da da — —

The heavy machine guns on the dozens of off-road vehicles opened fire. The muzzles spewed out thick flames, and the bullets chased after them. The distance was long, so there was no accuracy to speak of. However, the range of the firepower was very wide. Trees were cut down one after another, and the stray bullets created countless sparks on the exterior armor of the cargo compartment.

Li Ya Lin glanced at the rearview mirror, and in the next moment, the rearview mirror was shattered by a stray bullet. She cursed under her breath, and maneuvered the heavy truck around the trees to avoid the bullets. The truck became very bumpy, and even her butt hurt from the jolting. The cargo compartment was even more chaotic, and the components were flying everywhere. Han Xiao hurriedly used the lock to secure the various equipment and weapons boxes.

Two bound captives were huddled in a corner, shivering.

At dusk, the setting sun was as red as blood.

Dozens of armored off-road vehicles were chasing after a black heavy truck. The heavy truck was running for its life, and the pursuers were chasing after it. Bullets were fired, and the sound of gunshots echoed through the forest. The sound of the engines of so many vehicles mixed together like a mad dragon, cruising through the forest at high speed. Even the wanderers in Crow Forest Town could faintly hear the movement, and they all looked at the source of the sound in shock.

Closer and closer … Closer and closer!

Suddenly, a heavy truck rushed out of the forest and into Crow Forest Town. Like a rampaging rhinoceros, it crashed into a small building, and directly smashed the building into ruins. The front of the truck was clearly deformed!

The heavy truck roared through the streets, and the wanderers on the street were horrified. They quickly rolled and crawled to hide. When the heavy truck passed by, they finally dared to look at the back of the heavy truck, and their faces were filled with horror. Before they could start to talk, more off-road vehicles rushed into the town, and a large number of buildings were destroyed. Crackling sounds could be heard, and ruins were everywhere.

A rain of bullets flew, and a large number of wanderers were killed by stray bullets. Screams filled the sky, and the ground was dyed red with blood.

The last glimmer of twilight faded away. When night fell, the heavy truck finally rushed out of the edge of the forest and came to a flat plain. The lights of the pursuers connected into a light dragon, cruising on the vast plain. The muzzles of the guns and cannons became the eye-catching light source.

On the plain, it was easier for the off-road vehicles to catch up.

The distance slowly closed. 600 meters, 500 meters, 400 meters!

"Zhang Wei, change into your armor!"

Zhang Wei was shocked. He had already changed into his armor in advance. When he activated it, he immediately felt the changes after the modification. With the endoskeleton providing power to move, he finally did not need to use much energy. Furthermore, his vision turned into an analysis interface, and a series of battlefield data appeared. It could even assist in aiming.

Zhang Wei was pleasantly surprised, and his eyes widened.

"So strong!"

Han Xiao was putting high-explosive sniper bullets into his anti-materiel rifle. Hearing this, he said calmly, "This is just the most basic modification."

Zhang Wei only had one thought at this moment. 360,000 yuan was really worth it!

Ding Ding Dang Dang! The sound of bullets hitting the heavy truck became more frequent!

"Return fire!"

Han Xiao roared, and Zhang Wei kicked open the door of the cargo compartment. Zhang Wei's field of vision suddenly opened up, and the helmet blocked his ferocious expression. He raised both of his hands, raised the large caliber triple-barrelled machine gun, and opened fire with a roar!

"Tu Tu Tu Tu —"

The high-frequency gunshots were deafening, and the thick gunfire crazily spewed out. The bullet shells were automatically thrown out and fell to the ground. The large-caliber bullets were like rainbows crossing the sky, dragging flames behind them as they shot into the armored vehicles!

Boom! The bulletproof windows of the two off-road vehicles were shattered, and the people in the vehicles were shot into sieves.

Two long chains of ammo were attached to the outside of Zhang Wei's thighs, and they were dragged all the way to his back, filling up an entire box. These were all ammo that Han Xiao had prepared for him, enough for the Battler Armored Prototype to unleash its firepower.

Dozens of armored off-road vehicles hurriedly spread out in formation to avoid Zhang Wei's strafing fire. At the same time, they returned fire with their mounted machine guns.

However, Zhang Wei stood at the door of the cargo compartment in his armor. The external armor was mixed with platinum alloy by Han Xiao. The bullets hit his body, and the durability dropped very slowly. Zhang Wei even held the hexagonal shield on his back in front of him to block the bullets. Most of the bullets were blocked by his reef-like body.

Han Xiao raised his sniper rifle and fired one high-explosive bullet after another, setting the pursuing vehicles on fire. The enemy drivers were caught off guard, and the flames burned the internal engines of the off-road vehicles. One by one, the vehicles were turned off.

However, more off-road vehicles quickly closed in, and the external armor of the heavy truck was densely filled with bullet holes.

This distance was enough!

Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he threw away the anti-materiel rifle. He took out the weapon box that contained the bamboo dragonfly version of the delayed high-explosive grenades and threw them out like they were free. The grenades flew close to the ground, and they just happened to fly under the chassis of the off-road vehicles and exploded!

"Boom!"

The armored off-road vehicle was lifted from the bottom by the explosion. Under the kinetic force of the remaining momentum, it flipped forward in the air and rotated 180 degrees before hitting the ground with its top. The fuel tank was ignited, causing a second explosion, and all the people inside were killed or injured.

The kill notifications on the screen were crazily refreshed.

Every time he flipped over an SUV, he would be able to kill at least four to eight enemies in the vehicle. Coupled with the experience gained from destroying vehicles, a single vehicle would give him 5,000 to 7,000 experience points. This made him even more excited to blow up an SUV.

The prepared grenades finally came in handy!

"Ah!"

Screams rang in his ears. Han Xiao hurriedly came back to his senses, and his heart sank when he saw that two captives had been killed by stray bullets.

"The captives are dead!"

The firepower of the pursuing off-road vehicles became sparse, and the people in the vehicles were scared out of their wits by the firepower of the heavy truck.

A single heavy truck had destroyed more than 20 of their armored vehicles. It was simply appalling.

Li Ya Lin suddenly became excited. "I see Hesla's army!"

Han Xiao looked out of the window. Under the night sky, a large number of Hesla's military vehicles appeared in front of them. They were moving slowly, and their lights were brightly lit.

…

"Reporting to the commander, there is a small group of troops exchanging fire in front!"

Carl looked at the video feed inside the command vehicle and was shocked by the scene in front of him.

More than twenty armored off-road vehicles were chasing after a heavy truck that was riddled with holes. Looking from afar, they left behind a trail of overturned off-road vehicles that were burning fiercely, like continuous beacons of war.

Carl was bewildered and uncertain.

The firepower of this team of Division 13 agents was ferocious!

It was rare to see a team of agents with such strong combat power. Their firepower was comparable to that of a modern army, and they were small in number and agile in movement. This kind of team was usually the trump card. He suppressed the shock in his heart and squinted his eyes.

Ye Fan, Winna, and the rest also saw this scene and were shocked.

A single heavy truck withstood the firepower of an entire convoy and killed half of the pursuing soldiers. What kind of firepower was this?

"That heavy truck has been hit by at least 1,000 bullets, and it is still moving!"

That heavy truck must have been specially modified. They saw with their own eyes that a grenade had struck the armor of the heavy truck. However, the armor of the heavy truck was only slightly deformed. If it had been a normal vehicle, it would have been blown up into the sky!

What kind of metal was that?

It was too hard!

Even the members of Division 13 were dumbfounded.

When did Zhang Wei's team become so strong?
